description: Add a simulated signup verification step to RegisterPage so an account is not active until verified. This builds on FEAT-001's rewritten RegisterPage (3 roles, BuyerProfile, no approval gating). The verification is a clearly-in-registration step (not a post-login action): after the user submits their details, a 6-digit code is generated and shown (frontend prototype, no live backend), the user enters it, and only a matching code completes registration and shows the success screen. The marketplace-flow role model from FEAT-001 is a prerequisite (RegisterPage roleOptions must already be the 3 roles).
steps: 1. src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx: add a `step` state of type `'details' | 'verify'` (default 'details') and a `code` state (string, the generated 6-digit code) and an `enteredCode` state (string). Keep all existing form state, validation, role options (already 3 from FEAT-001), company fields (isBuyer), and password-strength logic intact.

2. In `handleSubmit` (the details-form submit): after `validate()` passes and `setErrors({})`, do NOT call register yet. Instead generate `const generated = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random()*900000).toString()`, `setCode(generated)`, `setEnteredCode('')`, and `setStep('verify')`. Keep the existing recycler/buyer profile payload construction (renamed buyerProfile by FEAT-001) ready to pass to register on verify-success. Add a small simulated 'send' delay (e.g. `await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400))`) and a loading state is acceptable but optional.

3. Add the verification step UI (rendered when `step === 'verify'`), inside the same AuthLayout card, BEFORE the existing details form block (wrap the existing details form in a `step === 'details' && (...)` guard so only one step shows at a time). The verify step must contain: a heading 'Verify your account'; an explanatory paragraph 'We sent a 6-digit verification code to . Enter it below to activate your account.'; a prominent prototype info banner (teal/amber styled, matching the existing banner patterns) that displays the generated code for this demo, e.g. 'Demo mode: your verification code is {code}'; a numeric input for the 6-digit code (use AuthInput with type='text' inputMode='numeric' maxLength=6, or a styled input matching the form); an error message slot for a mismatch; a primary 'Verify & Create Account' button (teal, same styling as the existing submit) that calls a new `handleVerify` function; a 'Resend code' text button that regenerates the code and resets enteredCode; and a 'Back' link/button that does `setStep('details')`. Keep the terms already accepted from the details step (do not re-show the terms checkbox).

4. Add `handleVerify`: if `enteredCode.trim() === code` (trim-safe, also accept if user types spaces), proceed: setLoading(true), build the typed `payload: RegisterPayload` (fullName/email/password/region/role/buyerProfile exactly as FEAT-001 constructs it), `await register(payload)`, `setSuccess(true)`. On mismatch set a local verify error 'Incorrect code. Please try again.' (do not throw). Wrap register in try/catch/finally like the original (error shown via authError). Disable the Verify button while loading (show a spinner with Loader2).

5. Update the success screen copy to reflect verification: change 'Registration Submitted!' context to convey the account is now verified/active, e.g. heading 'Account Verified!' and body 'Your account is verified and active. You can now sign in.' Keep the 'Go to Sign In' Link. Remove any leftover 'confirmation email once reviewed' wording (FEAT-001 already removed the approval block; ensure the success body does not mention admin review).

6. Ensure no new TS errors and no unused imports: the `useNavigate` removal and `RegisterPayload` usage from FEAT-001 remain valid; `code`/`enteredCode`/`step` are all used. Do NOT add any npm dependency. Do NOT persist the code anywhere durable (it lives in component state).
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with zero TS errors.

RegisterPage has two visible steps within one registration flow: (1) details+role selection, (2) verification code entry. The user cannot reach the success/active screen without entering the correct code.
The generated 6-digit code is displayed to the user in the verify step (frontend simulation) and the 'Verify & Create Account' action only succeeds when the entered code matches.
The verification step is part of signup (same page/flow), not a separate post-login screen, and the success screen states the account is verified/active (no admin-review wording).
Existing form validation, the 3 role options, company fields for Buyer, and password-strength UI remain intact.
verification: Run `npm run build` from `c:\Users\THIS PC\Desktop\aquasoursehub` — must exit 0, no TS errors.

Manual: `npm run dev`, open /register, fill the form, pick a role, submit — confirm you land on the verify step showing a 6-digit code; enter a wrong code and confirm an error; enter the shown code and confirm the success 'Account Verified!' screen appears.
